_comment: klt erc supply spec for sg13cmos5l-bandgap_top.gds -- the structural
power-delivery artifact T1 item 11 (klayout-tools#2025) requires, per
issue #225. Tie declaration added by issue #233; migrated to this repo
from 2AMLogic/sg13g2-bandgap at 52535387e6cc (blob 2888bc22797f) by
decision record 0020, whose baseline run kept this file byte-identical
and reproduced the source's ten erc.missing_tie findings on
nwell_tap_vdd (klt 0.8.0, KLayout 0.30.13, stream sha256:4e4e4f85fa08...,
spec sha256:d01f01b8b875...). The ties[] block below is this repo's
revision of that declaration; everything else is the migrated spec.
Run it against the committed top-level assembly GDS:
klt erc layout/sg13cmos5l-bandgap_top/sg13cmos5l-bandgap_top.gds \
layout/sg13cmos5l-bandgap_top/erc-supply-spec.json --format json
The stream has exactly one top cell (sg13cmos5l_bandgap_top), so --top is
not needed. Commit the JSON output as erc_report.json next to this spec.
What this spec asserts, and why each field is shaped this way:
- stackup[0] MUST carry role: "gate" (klt erc's own contract), so the
stack starts at GatPoly (5/0), CMOS5L's gate-poly conductor. Every
layer/datatype below is read from the resolved CMOS5L technology's own
libs.tech/klayout/tech/sg13cmos5l.lyp <name>/<source> entries (IHP
release v0.2.0) and cross-checked against klt's curated sg13cmos5l deck
(layout/common_sg13cmos5l.py's layer table records the same read-off;
layout/README.md 'SG13CMOS5L layer numbers' documents it) -- not copied
from gf180mcu's or sky130's spec.
- active_layer (Activ, 1/0) makes the antenna denominator poly ∩ diff
instead of raw poly area. This block carries real poly resistors
(R1/R2 rppd, RPU rhigh) whose GatPoly bars have no gate oxide; without
active_layer they would enter gates[] as pseudo-gates and report
non-physical antenna ratios (klayout-tools docs/cli/erc.md, 'Gate
area: poly ∩ diff vs. raw poly area').
- Metal1 (8/0) is the only routing metal this single-metal block uses
(buses and approach stubs are Metal1; inter-cell risers are GatPoly,
joined through Cont -- layout/sg13cmos5l-bandgap_top/generate.py's
routing-invariant corollaries). label_layer 8/2 is Metal1.pin, the
curated sg13cmos5l deck's own net-name layer
(EXTRACTION_DECK.metal_labels == ((8, 2),)) and the only layer this
GDS puts net text on: 80 labels including all 10 'vdd' and all 27 'vss'
occurrences (counted on the committed GDS, not assumed; the 10 vdd
labels include the two #240 well-tap tags the source spec's older
count of 8 predates).
- vias[]: Cont (6/0) is the single inter-level bridge of this stack,
connecting GatPoly and Metal1. Contacts landing on Activ (source/drain
and emitter/collector taps) share the GDS layer but bridge nothing in
this model -- Activ is not a stackup conductor, it appears only as
active_layer.
- nets[]: vdd and vss, both kind: "supply", which is what makes a short
between them report as the severe erc.supply_short rather than the
general erc.multiply_driven_net. Each must resolve to exactly ONE
electrical island: erc.unconnected_net fires on zero matches and on
more than one (a rail split into pieces that never touch), so ZERO
findings naming either supply is exactly the 'one island per supply'
verdict item 11 requires -- not merely an absence of evidence.
Signal nets (fb, sns1, sns2, vref, ...) are deliberately NOT declared:
item 11 is the structural supply question only.
- ties[]: three declarations, one per well population the stream
actually draws, using the capabilities klt 0.8.0 ships: per-class
well selection (well_requires/well_excludes, the closed
klayout-tools#2354) and a native-substrate tie (well_layer: null +
well_complement_of, the closed klayout-tools#2255). The source spec's
single nwell_tap_vdd declaration graded every NWell island against
vdd, so the ten pnpMPA base wells -- correctly tied to vss through
their #240 nSD-marked base rings -- could never satisfy it; that is
the ten-finding baseline decision record 0020 reproduces. Every
NWell (31/0) island on the committed GDS was probed and falls in
exactly one of three populations, counted, not assumed:
- Two MOS shared wells (bandgap_core's mirror well, bandgap_amp's),
the only NWell islands that interact with GatPoly (5/0) -- they
carry the pMOS gates. Each holds exactly one nSD-covered Activ
tap island (draw_well_tap, issue #240) wired through Cont to
Metal1 and into the vdd rail. nwell_tap_vdd selects this class
with well_requires: ["5/0"]; its tap is tap_layer Activ (1/0)
narrowed by tap_requires: ["7/0"] -- nSD-covered Activ, the same
boolean-implant shape the curated deck's own tap_nplus derivation
uses (klayout-tools#1273) and the gf180mcu example in
docs/cli/erc.md (Comp ∩ Nplus), because a bare tap_layer matching
every source/drain contact in the well is the unfalsifiable form
the degenerate-tie rule (klayout-tools#2199) exists to catch.
- Ten pnpMPA base wells -- exactly the gate-free NWell islands; the
complementary selector well_excludes: ["5/0"] keeps them, so the
two entries together grade every n-well exactly once (the
complementary-pair shape docs/cli/erc.md's 'One well layer, two
bias classes' section documents: device-body wells on one rail, a
diode-connected vertical bipolar's base tub on the other). Each
base well's n+ base ring is drawn Activ with the explicit nSD
marker ring #240 added over it (decision record 0018 keeps it),
contacted up through Cont to the Metal1 base ring labelled vss.
pnp_base_well_tap_vss declares that tie to net vss, with the same
tap_requires: ["7/0"] shape so the graded tap is the marked base
ring, not any contact in the well.
- The native p-substrate: no drawn p-well/tub layer exists anywhere
on this stream, declared the way klt 0.8.0 makes expressible:
well_layer: null with well_complement_of: ["31/0"], so the graded
region is the top-cell extent minus the merged n-well union,
derived from the stream instead of a hand-maintained well_boxes
list (klayout-tools#3750). Its tap is pSD-covered Activ
(tap_requires: ["14/0"], the deck's own tap_pplus shape): the ten
pnpMPA collector rings outside every NWell, 10 polygons /
75.74 um^2 total, each contacted up to a Metal1 ring labelled vss.
Graded as checked_by_well_assertion -- the weaker provenance a
region-with-no-drawn-layer always carries -- and falsifiable both
ways: a collector ring cut off from vss reports the ordinary
erc.missing_tie for its piece of the region.
Both well-selector entries stay falsifiable through the selection
itself: if a future revision routes a GatPoly riser across a pnpMPA
well, that well joins the vdd class and fails it -- the declaration
names what the design is, and the run says so when it stops being
true. A selection keeping every well, or none, is skipped as
degenerate_well_selection rather than read as a pass.
ties_disclosure is omitted on purpose: all three classes are
declared and checked, so there is no undeclared tie class to
disclose -- erc_coverage.inapplicable carries no 'no_ties_declared'
entry and no undeclared_classes name is needed.
